items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I remember two of the trumpet players. One guys name was Snuffy Claus.

ctx.x: Do you recall who some of the players were?
I remember two of the trumpet players. One guys name was Snuffy Claus. His brother Charlie, had been with the band just before I joined.
He was a trumpet player, wasn't he?
